classify-1.description: Recommended - ScaleDown Classify 1, decision model for boolean, choice and score questions; context window and output limit not established

classify.description: ScaleDown's name for its latest Classify model; whether it moves to a newer model is not established

rules.hint: ScaleDown answers HTTP 402 both when the account has no credit left and when it does not recognise the API key; check {apiKeyEnvVar} first.

setup.description: API key from ScaleDown (see its documentation). Sign-up gives a free allowance; whether it expires is not established
instructions: 1. Create an account and an API key, following https://docs.scaledown.ai
3. ScaleDown's documentation says the key goes in an x-api-key header rather than Authorization: Bearer, and NeuroLink sends it that way

4. ScaleDown's documentation says a request made with no credit left returns HTTP 402; a live test on 2026-10-20 saw it return 402 for an unrecognised key as well, so check {apiKeyEnvVar} before adding credit

rosterVerified.method: Checked by the marketing session, not in this change: ScaleDown's docs at docs.scaledown.ai were read and probes were made against api.scaledown.xyz. No request was made to ScaleDown in this change
